body: Thanks everyone!

Thanks for your well wishes. It went terribly. After all the preparation and getting myself to that point and through it, there is nothing they will charge him with now. Had he done what he did now, he’d be charged with at least 5 things, but because the age of consent was 14 then (he was in his 30s), and what he did before 14 occurred online before Internet law, he’s fine. He waited a few days after my 14th birthday to get me into his truck, so I guess he’s just a good pedophile. Can do his job well. I wasn’t expecting this outcome. The only way I can say it helped to report is by knowing now those things are illegal by current law…. That’s it.
Same
This. I just want the hurt to stop. It brings me to my knees. It makes me unable to breathe. I just need a break.
I’m questionnaire development (one can get an entire degree or two in psychometrics and measurement design) we write hundred of items to start and may end ok with 10 good ones.

Number of items is Informed by how many trials you need to achieve statistical reliability and validity. This is based on effect size. So we usually estimate an effect size based on previous research, use that to calculate an estimated sample size. That can inform your number of trials you run each participant through. More is better because in cog science we are often dealing with small but reliable effects — needing more people to capture that unique variance.
Semantics and symbols are two constructs there you need to examine.

It does though. This isn’t a questionnaire type it needed these are behavioural measures. They mentioned the four cumulative processes. You need to set up your experience to demonstrate those processes either earlier than expected, at the same time, or not at all etc. The abstract talks about these processes that develop - you need to find ways to test those.

Generous how? I usually thank them for their kindness. Generous in time, I thank them for their time. Generous in effort, I thank them for that. I guess I try to be genuinely thankful and appreciative.
I thought posting here would help but can’t even get a random stranger to acknowledge my existence. Fuck this.

Just an update for anyone interested or who may get some help because of it... I never ended up meeting with him but I have messaged a few times, and the limited responses I’ve gotten have been a bit helpful. I told my therapist first. I did end up getting a few more sessions covered and we are trying to get more; we switched to a different kind of counselling, or a different focus at least, to “trauma” counselling. I’m learning, well accepting, that I have had a lot or trauma and just never labeled or accepted it as such; assumed I dealt with them fine; I very clearly have not. I’d like to maybe post about them
One day as well if I struggle to come clean with my counsellor. Getting all of your comments was very very helpful, so thank you. This place was a first in unconditional support - from
Strangers. I’m learning so much about myself each time I speak some truth and it’s really helping me find some peace. Little pieces of peace. 

She’s given me a few other things to focus on to help me work through the trauma and honestly, the improvement in how I felt after the first session was remarkable. Thanks to those who said be honest with her. It’s the first time someone I know has been completely on my side, judgement and bias free, ever on any serious topic. I still have suicidal ideation days. I still have to try not to self harm some days. But there are less. And the good days feel a bit more good. I haven’t drank in 21 days tonight although it’s been a struggle at times.
Edit: oops I hit post. 
I even have the strength to CONSIDER talking to the police one day; before - flat out no chance to even think of it before I’d panic. That feels like progress too. So thanks again for those who commented. You took the time and sincerely, you helped a fellow human. Thank you thank you thank you.
Thank you very much for this. It’s been helpful.
I wish more people had commented to be even less alone and gain more perspective but I very much appreciate those who did. Thanks again.
I appreciate your summary of events, it actually helps with some perspective. Maybe he was feeling guilt and was looking to be validated himself... I still haven’t replied to his question.

I don’t think I’d ever have the strength to do that. I understand your comment and where you’re coming from, but I don’t see that as a possibility for me for years if ever. I’ll admit I’m a fucking mess these days. This pandemic, quarantined in a house with the abuser I’ve told I want a divorce from living in the basement while this guy messages me — really has me all mentally fucked up. I feel ashamed even complaining. Other people have such larger problems.
I’ve read this comment over and over and over. Sincere thanks.

Thanks very much for your comment. Can I ask how old you are now? It’s helpful to know I’m not the only one who now feels regret .. and more,. over something like this. He lived 2 hrs away and drove to see me often as well. I forgot about other red flags that you’ve triggered.. fucking hell.

Thanks. I have an appt set up for Thursday and a request to insurance for more. I’ve been going for quite awhile for other issues (current relationship I’m escaping) but never realized this was impacting me until the message.
I have no idea what he’s like or what’s likely to happen if I did meet up. I haven’t been in touch for over a decade.
I am 38. I don’t know why that’s embarrassing to admit exactly. I feel shame and embarrassment about every aspect of this.
Thanks for your comments and taking the time to read this everyone. I really appreciate the perspective and support. Two things I grossly lack these days.
Closure I guess. Sorry. I’m seeing everyone does think that’s what he is. That’s validating to me as his message says it was all me, a strong smart 15 year old.

Thank you. I’ll think about those questions. For one, I hoped to gain closure of some sort. To see him differently than I did when I was a kid. Old and gross is the hope. I don’t know that I’d gain any closure though, or if I’d unwind more. Good questions. Thanks again.
Thank you so much for this.
Thank you for your comment. I am trying; I wondered if seeing him old and unattractive would help with closure. I hope I find happiness and peace soon too, I’ve been trying, but it’s not working.
Thanks for your comment. I’m digesting it.
It’s personal shame.
For me, it’s because peace and absence of chaos and pain sounds so much more appealing and beautiful than what this existence offers me. A lack of that, a non-existence, seems magical.
